name: Ngheu Khai Long
summary: Nghêu Khai Long is the clam of the Khai Long flat, thick-fleshed and free of sand. It is steamed over lemongrass and crushed ginger until the shells open and eaten hot.
origin: Bãi Khai Long. The flat is busiest after Tết through the end of May and June.
howToEat: Lemongrass and crushed ginger go under the clams, with chili if you want it, until the shells open.
Eat them hot with muối tiêu chanh or nước mắm chua ngọt.
where: Bãi Khai Long, on the cape day.
seoTitle: Ngheu Khai Long — clams after Tet
seoDescription: Nghêu Khai Long is the thick, sand-free clam of the flat beside the cape, steamed with lemongrass and ginger. The busy harvest runs after Tết through May and June.
